NsfStageSelectQ.value: 'SELECT 1218  AS BATCHID,RCPT.BLEI_CK,          BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL,          BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK,          SBSB.SBSB_CK,          RCPT.rcpt_id,          RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID,          RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID,          RCPT.RCPT_RCPT_CD,          RCPT.RCPT_MCTR_RSN,          RCPT.RCPT_AMT,          RCPT.RCPT_STS,          MEPE.PDPD_ID,          BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,          BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_END_DT,           FEE.FEEAMOUNT AS NSF_FEE_AMT,          CASE WHEN FEE.FEEAMOUNT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed'               ELSE 'Failed' END  AS SBSR_STATUS FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = RCPT.BLEI_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB      ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD      ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK      AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME      ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE      ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'      AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT LEFT JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_FEESETUP FEE      ON FEE.GROUPID = RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID WHERE      RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'     AND REGEXP_LIKE (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]')      AND RCPT.rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN  ('F','N')     AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'  UNION  SELECT 1218  AS BATCHID, RCPT.Blei_ck,          BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL,          BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK,          SBSB.SBSB_CK,          RCPT.rcpt_id,          RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID,          RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID,          RCPT.RCPT_RCPT_CD,          RCPT.RCPT_MCTR_RSN,          RCPT.RCPT_AMT,          RCPT.RCPT_STS,          MEPE.PDPD_ID,          BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,          BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_END_DT,           FEE.FEEAMOUNT AS NSF_FEE_AMT,          CASE WHEN FEE.FEEAMOUNT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed'               ELSE 'Failed' END  AS SBSR_STATUS FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = RCPT.BLEI_CK  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG      ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD      ON SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'FAML'      AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000      AND BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB      ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR      ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME      ON MEME.SBSB_CK=SBSB.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE      ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'      AND  TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT  JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_FEESETUP FEE      ON FEE.GROUPID = GRGR.GRGR_ID WHERE      GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'     AND regexp_like (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]')      AND rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN  ('F','N')     AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B''

gv_Delinquency_EMPL.value: 'WITH MAX_BLIV_ID as ( SELECT MAX(BLIV_ID)as MAX_BLIV_ID,BLEI_CK FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE  EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL_DUE_DT)  = EXTRACT (MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') )  GROUP BY BLEI_CK ) select DISTINCT  CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+42,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END    AS GRACEEXPDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS PREMDUEDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS BILLDATEFROM ,TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,'MMDDYYYY') AS BILLDATETO ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'),'MMDDYYYY') AS  CURRDTE2 ,BLIV.BLIV_ID AS INVOICENBR ,BGBG.BGBG_ID AS MEMBERID ,BGBG.BGBG_MCTR_LANG AS LANGCD ,'15NOTS' as OUTFIND ,BGBG.BGBG_NAME AS GROUPNAME ,BGBG.BGBG_ID AS GROUPBILLINGENTITY ,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID ,MEPE.CSPI_ID AS PLANID ,MEPE.CSCS_ID AS CLASSID  ,'SUMMBILL' as TCFileInd ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS PREMDUE ,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS TOTAMT ,REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') AS  SUBADDRCAREOF ,REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET SUB_ADDR_STREET, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, BGBG.BGBG_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, BGBG.BGBG_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4) AS GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY  INSB.BLIV_ID ORDER BY INSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM DESC) AS RNK FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'EMPL' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK   JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                            JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT ON RCPT.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND regexp_like (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]')      AND rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN ('N','F')  WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0 ) SELECT  DISTINCT BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, BLIV_ID ,RANK 				FROM NSF_REBILL  WHERE RNK =1           '

gv_NSFS_R.value: ' with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (  SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM GROUP BY BLEI_CK ) ,NSF_REBILL AS ( SELECT DISTINCT BGBG.BGBG_NAME AS GROUP_NAME, BGBG.BGBG_ID as BILLING_GROUP_ID,CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE, RCPT.RCPT_AMT AS NSF_FEE, GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, BGBG.BGBG_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, BGBG.BGBG_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as TOT_AMT, INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, INSB.BLIV_ID , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BGBG.BGBG_ID ORDER BY GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY  INSB.BLIV_ID ORDER BY INSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM DESC) AS RNK FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'EMPL' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK   JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                            JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT ON RCPT.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND regexp_like (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]')      AND rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN ('N','F')  WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0 ) SELECT  DISTINCT GROUP_NAME,BILLING_GROUP_ID, GRACE_EXP_DTE, NSF_FEE, GROUP_ID, CSCS_ID, PLAN_ID, SUB_ADDR_STREET, SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, SUB_ADDR_CITY, SUB_ADDR_ST, SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, TOT_AMT, BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, BLIV_ID ,RANK 				FROM NSF_REBILL  WHERE RNK =1           '

('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE, NSF.NSF_FEE_AMT as NSF_FEE, GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, NSF.RCPT_AMT as TOT_AMT, INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, INSB.BLIV_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY  INSB.BLIV_ID ORDER BY INSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM DESC) AS RANK FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT'  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'  AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT on DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT    JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                  WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                  AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                                JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_STAGE NSF ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0) SELECT  SUB_FST_NME, 				SUB_MID_INIT, 				SUB_LST_NME, 				MEMBER_ID, 				GRACE_EXP_DTE, 				NSF_FEE, 				GROUP_ID, 				CSCS_ID, 				PLAN_ID, 				SUB_ADDR_STREET, 				SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, 				SUB_ADDR_CITY, 				SUB_ADDR_ST, 				SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, 				SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, 				TOT_AMT, 				BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, 				BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, 				MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, 				BLIV_ID  				FROM NSF_REBILL  WHERE RANK =1 '

gv_NSFP2.value: 'with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (  SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM GROUP BY BLEI_CK )  SELECT DISTINCT BGBG.BGBG_ID as BILLING_GROUP_ID, SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as SUB_FST_NME, SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUB_MID_INIT, SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME as SUB_LST_NME, CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_ID <> SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID THEN SBSB_DEP.SBSB_FIRST_NAME ELSE NULL END as DEP_FST_NME, CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_ID <> SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID THEN SBSB_DEP.SBSB_MID_INIT ELSE NULL END as DEP_MID_INIT, CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_ID <> SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID THEN SBSB_DEP.SBSB_LAST_NAME ELSE NULL END as DEP_LST_NME, SBSB.SBSB_ID as MEMBER_ID, CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_ID <> SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID THEN SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID   ELSE NULL END  as DEP_MEMBER_ID, CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE, NSF.NSF_FEE_AMT as NSF_FEE, GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, NSF.RCPT_AMT as TOT_AMT, INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, INSB.BLIV_ID  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'FAML' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP_FAM ON DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = BGBG.BGBG_ID JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB_DEP ON SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID = DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK   JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                              JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_STAGE NSF ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'

gv_Delinquency_I.value: 'WITH MAX_BLIV_ID as ( SELECT MAX(BLIV_ID)as MAX_BLIV_ID,BLEI_CK FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') GROUP BY BLEI_CK )  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+42,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END    AS GRACEEXPDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS PREMDUEDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS BILLDATEFROM ,TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,'MMDDYYYY') as BILLDATETO ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'),'MMDDYYYY') AS CURRDTE2 ,BLIV.BLIV_ID as INVOICENBR ,SBSB.SBSB_ID as MEMBERID ,MEME.MEME_MCTR_LANG as LANGCD ,CASE WHEN SBAD.SBAD_TYPE='D' THEN '15NOTP3' ELSE '15NOT' END as OUTFIND ,PLDS.PLDS_DESC as PLANNAME ,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID ,MEPE.CSPI_ID AS PLANID ,MEPE.CSCS_ID AS CLASSID ,CASE WHEN SBAD.SBAD_TYPE='D' THEN '3RDPARTY' ELSE '' END AS TCFileInd ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS PREMDUE ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS TOTAMT ,SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as SUBFSTNME ,SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUBMIDINIT ,SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME as SUBLSTNME ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRCAREOF ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET3 ,SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS SUBADDRCITY ,SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS SUBADDRST ,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUBADDRZIP5 ,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUBADDRZIP4 ,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT ,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as MODALITY ,case when (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN CAST(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 AS DECIMAL (10,2)) else cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 AS DECIMAL (10,2)) END AS TOL_BILLEDAMT ,BLEI.BLEI_CK AS BILLINGENTITYKEY ,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL ,SYSDATE as RUNDATE ,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT ,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE as SBAD_TYPE ,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL as SBAD_TYPE_MAIL ,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME as SBAD_TYPE_HOME ,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT ,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND ,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS   FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE 'CA%' JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('FAML', 'EMPL') JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe   ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD  ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND NOT IN ('B','D','X') JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT NOT IN ('FAML','EMPL','EFT','NONE') AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT  AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM =(SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK   AND (INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) = (SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM) , MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = INID.BLEI_CK AND BLBL_DUE_DT>=INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN MAX_BLIV_ID ON BLIV.BLIV_ID=MAX_BLIV_ID.MAX_BLIV_ID JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(BLBL_DUE_DT) AS DUE_DT,BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM WHERE BLBL_PAID_STS NOT IN ('3','2') AND BLBL_BILLED_AMT<>0 GROUP BY BLEI_CK) DT ON DT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  WHERE BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT< (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 ELSE BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 END)  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')) = 15 AND CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END>0 AND CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT ELSE DT.DUE_DT END < BLBL.BLBL_END_DT'

gv_Delinquency_FAML.value: 'WITH MAX_BLIV_ID as ( SELECT MAX(BLIV_ID)as MAX_BLIV_ID,BLEI_CK from FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL_DUE_DT)  = EXTRACT (MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') ) GROUP BY BLEI_CK )  select DISTINCT  CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY')       WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+42,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END    AS GRACEEXPDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS PREMDUEDTE ,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS BILLDATEFROM ,TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,'MMDDYYYY') AS BILLDATETO ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'),'MMDDYYYY') AS CURRDTE2 ,BLIV.BLIV_ID AS INVOICENBR ,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS MEMBERID ,DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID AS DEPENDENTID ,MEME.MEME_MCTR_LANG AS LANGCD ,'15NOTP2' as OUTFIND ,PLDS.PLDS_DESC AS PLANNAME ,DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID AS GROUPBILLINGENTITY ,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID ,MEPE.CSPI_ID AS PLANID ,MEPE.CSCS_ID AS CLASSID ,'2P1P' as TCFileInd ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS PREMDUE ,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT ,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END as TOTAMT ,SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as SUBFSTNME ,SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUBMIDINIT ,SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME as SUBLSTNME ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRCAREOF ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET ,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET3 ,SBAD.SBAD_CITY  AS SUBADDRCITY ,SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS SUBADDRST ,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUBADDRZIP5 ,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4)  AS SUBADDRZIP4 ,SBSB_DEP.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as DEPFSTNME ,SBSB_DEP.SBSB_MID_INIT as DEPMIDINIT ,SBSB_DEP.SBSB_LAST_NAME as DEPLSTNME ,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as MODALITY ,case when (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 as decimal (10,2)) else cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 as decimal (10,2)) end as TOL_BILLEDAMT ,BLEI.BLEI_CK as BillingEntityKey ,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL ,SYSDATE as RUNDATE ,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT ,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE AS SBAD_TYPE ,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL as SBAD_TYPE_MAIL ,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME as SBAD_TYPE_HOME ,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT ,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND ,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE 'CA%' JOIN AGP.BILLING_MEDISYS_MDSUPP MD ON MD.SBSB_ID =SBSB.SBSB_ID AND MD.MODALITY_BILL_PAY_METHOD<>'E' JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE on MEME.MEME_CK=MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP='FAML' AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK=BGBG.BGBG_CK  JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP_FAM ON DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = BGBG.BGBG_ID AND DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID!=DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID and DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_ACTIVE='Y' JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB_DEP ON SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID = DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL between BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE  WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT GROUP BY BLIV.BLEI_CK) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK   AND (INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) = (SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM) , MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = INID.BLEI_CK AND BLBL_DUE_DT>=INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN MAX_BLIV_ID ON BLIV.BLIV_ID=MAX_BLIV_ID.MAX_BLIV_ID JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(BLBL_DUE_DT) AS DUE_DT,BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM WHERE BLBL_PAID_STS NOT IN ('3','2') AND BLBL_BILLED_AMT<>0 GROUP BY BLEI_CK) DT ON DT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  WHERE  BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT< (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 ELSE BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 END) AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')=(14+BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')) = 15 AND CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END>0 AND CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT ELSE DT.DUE_DT END < BLBL.BLBL_END_DT '

TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE, RCPT.RCPT_AMT AS NSF_FEE, GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, BGBG.BGBG_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, BGBG.BGBG_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as TOT_AMT, INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, INSB.BLIV_ID , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BGBG.BGBG_ID ORDER BY GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY  INSB.BLIV_ID ORDER BY INSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM DESC) AS RNK FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'EMPL' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK   JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                            JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT ON RCPT.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND regexp_like (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]')      AND rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN ('N','F')  WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0 ) SELECT  DISTINCT GROUP_NAME,BILLING_GROUP_ID, GRACE_EXP_DTE, NSF_FEE, GROUP_ID, CSCS_ID, PLAN_ID, SUB_ADDR_STREET, SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, SUB_ADDR_CITY, SUB_ADDR_ST, SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, TOT_AMT, BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, BLSB_COV_THRU_DT, MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT, BLIV_ID ,RANK 				FROM NSF_REBILL  WHERE RNK =1           '

'FAML' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP_FAM ON DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF, SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5, SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4, RCPT.RCPT_RCVD_DT as SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE on MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')  Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'    JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK and BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS in ('1','2') JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT on DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK and BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'CPN' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT      AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)  JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID       AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL                                   WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)        LEFT OUTER JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT     ON inpa.RCPT_ID = rcpt.rcpt_id                                and RCPT.RCPT_RCPT_CD in ('B','C','D','E','P') AND RCPT.RCPT_STS not in ('V9','VC')    AND RCPT.RCPT_CREATE_DTM >  TO_DATE('4/28/2016','mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM')'

gv_RRDS.defaultValue:
'with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (

SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK
from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM
GROUP BY BLEI_CK
)
SELECT DISTINCT

BGBG.BGBG_NAME as GROUP_NAME,
BGBG.BGBG_ID as BILLING_ENTITY,
BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1 as EMP_ADDR_STREET,
BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 as EMP_ADDR_CARE_OF,
BGBG.BGBG_CITY as EMP_ADDR_CITY,
BGBG.BGBG_STATE as EMP_ADDR_ST,
SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS EMP_ADDR_ZIP5,
SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4) AS EMP_ADDR_ZIP4,
GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID,
MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID,
MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID,
INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
BLIV.BLIV_ID,
PLDS.PLDS_DESC as PLAN_NAME , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BGBG.BGBG_ID ORDER BY GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK,BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as NET_DUE  
FROM
FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
	ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
     AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
    AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT    
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
    ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP IN ('EMPL')
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG 
    ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK  
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
	ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK 
	AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 
	ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
INNER JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT 
	ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
	and BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV 
	ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK 
	AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
    AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                                WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
 
INNER JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB 
	ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
    AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS 
	ON PLDS.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID 
WHERE MEPE.PDPD_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT *  FROM AGP.PRODUCT_ID_LKP) AND BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'

gv_Delinquency_EMPL.defaultValue:
'WITH MAX_BLIV_ID as (
SELECT MAX(BLIV_ID)as MAX_BLIV_ID,BLEI_CK
FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE  EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL_DUE_DT)  = EXTRACT (MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') )
 GROUP BY BLEI_CK
) select DISTINCT 
CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY') 
     WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+42,'MMDDYYYY')
ELSE TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END    AS GRACEEXPDTE
,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS PREMDUEDTE
,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS BILLDATEFROM
,TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,'MMDDYYYY') AS BILLDATETO
,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'),'MMDDYYYY') AS  CURRDTE2
,BLIV.BLIV_ID AS INVOICENBR
,BGBG.BGBG_ID AS MEMBERID
,BGBG.BGBG_MCTR_LANG AS LANGCD
,'15NOTS' as OUTFIND
,BGBG.BGBG_NAME AS GROUPNAME
,BGBG.BGBG_ID AS GROUPBILLINGENTITY
,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID
,MEPE.CSPI_ID AS PLANID
,MEPE.CSCS_ID AS CLASSID 
,'SUMMBILL' as TCFileInd
,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS PREMDUE
,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT
,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS TOTAMT
,REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') AS  SUBADDRCAREOF
,REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET 
,REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET3
,BGBG.BGBG_CITY  AS SUBADDRCITY
,BGBG.BGBG_STATE AS SUBADDRST
,SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS SUBADDRZIP5
,SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4)  AS SUBADDRZIP4
,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as MODALITY
,CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN CAST(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 as decimal (10,2)) else cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 as decimal (10,2)) end as TOL_BILLEDAMT
,BLEI.BLEI_CK as BillingEntityKey
,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL
,SYSDATE as RUNDATE
,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT
,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT
,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND
,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BGBG.BGBG_ID ORDER BY GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK 
FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on MEME.MEME_CK=MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBSD.SBSB_CK  AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP='EMPL' AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK=BGBG.BGBG_CK
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLEI.BLEI_CK=BLDF.BLEI_CK and bldf.bldf_mctr_stmt='EMPL' AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT !='EFT' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') between BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
     AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK  
AND (INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) = (SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM) , MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = INID.BLEI_CK AND BLBL_DUE_DT>=INID.BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN MAX_BLIV_ID ON BLIV.BLIV_ID=MAX_BLIV_ID.MAX_BLIV_ID
JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID 
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(BLBL_DUE_DT) AS DUE_DT,BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM WHERE BLBL_PAID_STS NOT IN ('3','2') AND BLBL_BILLED_AMT<>0 GROUP BY BLEI_CK) DT ON DT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
WHERE BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT< (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 ELSE BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 END) AND
TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')=(14+BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT) 
AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')) = 15 AND CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END>0
AND CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT ELSE DT.DUE_DT END < BLBL.BLBL_END_DT'

'with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (

SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK
from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM
GROUP BY BLEI_CK
)   

SELECT DISTINCT
SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,
SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT,
SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME,
SBSB.SBSB_ID Member_ID,
SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET,
SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF,
SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY,
SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4,
GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID,
MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID,
MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID,
PLDS.PLDS_DESC as PLAN_NAME,
INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
BLIV.BLIV_ID,BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as NET_DUE 
FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
	ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD
	ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBAD.SBSB_CK
	AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME = 'H'
	AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = 'H'
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
    AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD 
    ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK     
	AND	SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT'
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
	ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK 
	AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'  
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 
	ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
INNER JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT 
	ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
	AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT
LEFT OUTER JOIN  FACETS.CMC_BLRC_BILL_RCPT INPA 
	ON BLBL.blei_ck = inpa.blei_ck
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV 
	ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK 
	AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
    AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                                WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
 
INNER JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB 
	ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
    AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)
								 
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON PLDS.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID		
WHERE MEPE.PDPD_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM AGP.PRODUCT_ID_LKP)  AND BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'

JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK

JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL

JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
     AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
     AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL

JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_STAGE NSF ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0)

				BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
				MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
				BLIV_ID 
				FROM NSF_REBILL 
WHERE RANK =1'

SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4,

BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as PREM_DUE,

JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE 'VASUP%'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE on MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')  Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'   
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK and BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS in ('1','2')
JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT on DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK and BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT
LEFT OUTER JOIN  FACETS.CMC_BLRC_BILL_RCPT INPA ON BLBL.blei_ck = inpa.blei_ck AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = inpa.BLBL_DUE_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'CPN' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT

                                AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT) 
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
     AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)       
LEFT OUTER JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT
    ON inpa.RCPT_ID = rcpt.rcpt_id

)

BGBG.BGBG_ID as BILLING_GROUP_ID,

SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUB_MID_INIT,

     WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY')
ELSE TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE,

MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID,

SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET,

SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY,
SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4,
NSF.RCPT_AMT as TOT_AMT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
INSB.BLIV_ID

FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR           
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'FAML' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK
JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP_FAM ON DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = BGBG.BGBG_ID
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB_DEP ON SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID = DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL

JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK

JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT

                                WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
     AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                             
JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_STAGE NSF ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'

gv_Delinquency_I.defaultValue:
'WITH MAX_BLIV_ID as (
SELECT MAX(BLIV_ID)as MAX_BLIV_ID,BLEI_CK
FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
WHERE BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')
GROUP BY BLEI_CK
) 
SELECT DISTINCT CASE
WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+36,'MMDDYYYY') 
     WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+42,'MMDDYYYY')
ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')),'MM/DD/YYYY')+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END    AS GRACEEXPDTE
,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS PREMDUEDTE
,CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(DT.DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY') END AS BILLDATEFROM
,TO_CHAR(BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,'MMDDYYYY') as BILLDATETO
,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy'),'MMDDYYYY') AS CURRDTE2
,BLIV.BLIV_ID as INVOICENBR
,SBSB.SBSB_ID as MEMBERID
,MEME.MEME_MCTR_LANG as LANGCD
,CASE WHEN SBAD.SBAD_TYPE='D' THEN '15NOTP3' ELSE '15NOT' END as OUTFIND
,PLDS.PLDS_DESC as PLANNAME
,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID
,MEPE.CSPI_ID AS PLANID
,MEPE.CSCS_ID AS CLASSID
,CASE WHEN SBAD.SBAD_TYPE='D' THEN '3RDPARTY' ELSE '' END AS TCFileInd
,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS PREMDUE
,CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END AS TOTAMT
,SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as SUBFSTNME
,SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUBMIDINIT
,SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME as SUBLSTNME
,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRCAREOF
,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET
,REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') AS SUBADDRSTREET3
,SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS SUBADDRCITY
,SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS SUBADDRST
,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUBADDRZIP5
,SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUBADDRZIP4
,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT
,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as MODALITY
,case when (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN CAST(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 AS DECIMAL (10,2)) else cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 AS DECIMAL (10,2)) END AS TOL_BILLEDAMT
,BLEI.BLEI_CK AS BILLINGENTITYKEY
,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL
,SYSDATE as RUNDATE
,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT
,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE as SBAD_TYPE
,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL as SBAD_TYPE_MAIL
,SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME as SBAD_TYPE_HOME
,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT
,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND
,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS  
FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE 'CA%'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('FAML', 'EMPL')
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe   ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD  ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND NOT IN ('B','D','X')
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT NOT IN ('FAML','EMPL','EFT','NONE') AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT 
AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM =(SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK  
AND (INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) = (SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM) , MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = INID.BLEI_CK AND BLBL_DUE_DT>=INID.BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN MAX_BLIV_ID ON BLIV.BLIV_ID=MAX_BLIV_ID.MAX_BLIV_ID
JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID 
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(BLBL_DUE_DT) AS DUE_DT,BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM WHERE BLBL_PAID_STS NOT IN ('3','2') AND BLBL_BILLED_AMT<>0 GROUP BY BLEI_CK) DT ON DT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
WHERE BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT< (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 ELSE BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 END) 
AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')) = 15 AND CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END>0
AND CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT ELSE DT.DUE_DT END < BLBL.BLBL_END_DT'

JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP='FAML' AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK=BGBG.BGBG_CK 
JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP_FAM ON DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = BGBG.BGBG_ID AND DEP_FAM.SUBSC_HCID!=DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID and DEP_FAM.FAMILYLINK_ACTIVE='Y'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB_DEP ON SBSB_DEP.SBSB_ID = DEP_FAM.DEP_HCID 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLEI.BLEI_CK=BLDF.BLEI_CK and BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT='FAML' AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT !='EFT' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') between BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
     AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE  WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT GROUP BY BLIV.BLEI_CK)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK  
AND (INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,INID.BLBL_DUE_DT) = (SELECT MAX (BLIV_CREATE_DTM) , MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE WHERE BLEI_CK = INID.BLEI_CK AND BLBL_DUE_DT>=INID.BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN MAX_BLIV_ID ON BLIV.BLIV_ID=MAX_BLIV_ID.MAX_BLIV_ID
JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID 
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(BLBL_DUE_DT) AS DUE_DT,BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM WHERE BLBL_PAID_STS NOT IN ('3','2') AND BLBL_BILLED_AMT<>0 GROUP BY BLEI_CK) DT ON DT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 
WHERE  BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT< (CASE WHEN (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 ELSE BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.95 END) AND
TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')=(14+BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT) 
AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy')) = 15 AND CASE WHEN INID.BLBL_DUE_DT =BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT THEN BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE ELSE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE - INID.BLBL_BILLED_AMT END>0
AND CASE WHEN DT.DUE_DT IS NULL THEN BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT ELSE DT.DUE_DT END < BLBL.BLBL_END_DT'

gv_NSF.defaultValue:
'with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (

SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK
from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM
GROUP BY BLEI_CK
)

SELECT DISTINCT
SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME as SUB_FST_NME,
SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT as SUB_MID_INIT,
SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME as SUB_LST_NME,
SBSB.SBSB_ID as MEMBER_ID,
CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY') 
     WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY')
ELSE TO_CHAR(NSF.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE,
NSF.NSF_FEE_AMT as NSF_FEE,
GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID,
MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID,
MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID,
SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET,
SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF,
SBAD.SBAD_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY,
SBAD.SBAD_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5,
SUBSTR(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4,
NSF.RCPT_AMT as TOT_AMT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
INSB.BLIV_ID

FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR           
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'  AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT on DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT   
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
     AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                                 WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
     AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                               
JOIN AGP.BOSS_NSF_STAGE NSF ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND NSF.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'

'with MAX_BLEI_DUE as (

SELECT MAX(BLBL_DUE_DT)as MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,BLEI_CK
from FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM
GROUP BY BLEI_CK
)

SELECT DISTINCT
BGBG.BGBG_NAME AS GROUP_NAME,
BGBG.BGBG_ID as BILLING_GROUP_ID,CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NVSUPWP0','NVSUP000') AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) in ('S','P') and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'NV%' THEN TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+36,'MMDDYYYY') 
     WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID='WISUPWP0' AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1)='W' and MEPE.CSPI_ID like 'WI%'  THEN TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT,'MMDDYYYY')
ELSE TO_CHAR(BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT+31,'MMDDYYYY')  END  AS GRACE_EXP_DTE,
RCPT.RCPT_AMT AS NSF_FEE,
GRGR.GRGR_ID as GROUP_ID,
MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID,
MEPE.CSPI_ID as PLAN_ID,
BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1 as SUB_ADDR_STREET,
BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 as SUB_ADDR_CARE_OF,
BGBG.BGBG_CITY as SUB_ADDR_CITY,
BGBG.BGBG_STATE as SUB_ADDR_ST,
SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,1,5) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP5,
SUBSTR(BGBG.BGBG_ZIP,6,4) AS SUB_ADDR_ZIP4,
BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as TOT_AMT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,
INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,
DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT,
INSB.BLIV_ID
, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BGBG.BGBG_ID ORDER BY GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID ) AS RANK FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR           
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('6/6/2021','mm/dd/yyyy') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'EMPL' AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK  
JOIN MAX_BLEI_DUE DDT ON DDT.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT = DDT.MAX_BLBL_DUE_DT
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
     AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                                WHERE BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK
                                AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL_DUE_DT)
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB ON  INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID 
     AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT = (SELECT MAX(BLSB_COV_FROM_DT) FROM FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL 
                                 WHERE BLIV_ID = INSB.BLIV_ID)                             
JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT ON RCPT.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND regexp_like (RCPT_MCTR_RSN,'R+[0-9]') 
    AND rcpt_rcpt_cd  IN ('N','F')  WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE>0'
